meaning: For each first unmoved mover, the existing simplicity reading excludes composition and esse other than essence and the first-being bridge excludes a distinct simply-prior being, so it has no represented limiting principle. The open bridge STMT-UNLIMITED-IS-OWN-BEING makes it its own being; SCG I.28 (as encoded) gives it every perfection of being; q.4 a.2 (restricted to pure perfections) makes every pure perfection such a perfection. This derives the former bare leaf STMT-FIRST-MOVER-HAS-EVERY-PURE-DETERMINATION. All five premises stay open; the two source-supported ones are weaker encodings of their passages.
